passages.text: Now Abraham had taken another wife, named Keturah, and she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was the father of the people of Israel.
Abraham took another wife.
Her name was Keturah.
Keturah gave birth to six sons for Abraham.
Their names were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃ וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־ יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־ מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־ יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־ שֽׁוּחַ׃

passages.text: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
passages.sermon:
Jokshan was a son of Abraham and Keturah.
Jokshan became the father of Sheba.
Jokshan also became the father of Dedan.
Dedan had sons.
The sons of Dedan were the Asshurites.
The sons of Dedan were also the Letushites.
The sons of Dedan were also the Leummites.
passages.original: וְיָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־ דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
passages.sermon:
Midian was a son of Abraham and Keturah.
Midian had five sons.
Their names were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
All these men were descendants of Keturah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃

passages.text: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
passages.sermon: Abraham was the father of Isaac.\r\nAbraham owned many things.\r\nAbraham gave everything he owned to Isaac.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃

passages.text: But while he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was the father of Isaac.
Abraham also had sons by his concubines.
Abraham gave gifts to these sons.
Abraham was still alive when he did this.
Abraham sent these sons away from Isaac.
Abraham sent them to the land of the east.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנוֹ֙ בְּעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃

passages.text: Abraham lived a total of 175 years.
passages.sermon: Abraham was a man chosen by God.\r\nAbraham lived for 175 years.\r\nThis was the total length of Abraham’s life.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־ חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was an old man.
He lived a long and good life.
He was satisfied with his years.
Abraham breathed his last.
He died.
He was gathered to his people.
passages.original: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃

passages.text: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
Isaac and Ishmael were Abraham’s sons.
Abraham died.
Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham.
They buried him in the cave of Machpelah.
The cave of Machpelah is near Mamre.
The cave is in the field of Ephron.
Ephron was the son of Zohar.
Ephron was a Hittite.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל־ שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־ צֹ֙חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃

passages.text: This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a man chosen by God.
Abraham bought a field from the Hittites.
The Hittites were a people who lived in the land.
Abraham owned this field because he purchased it.
Abraham was buried in this field.
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
Sarah was also buried in this field.
passages.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵי־ חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְשָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
passages.sermon:
Abraham died.
God blessed Isaac.
Isaac was Abraham’s son.
Isaac lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם־ בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ס

passages.text: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Hagar was Ishmael’s mother.
Hagar was Egyptian.
Hagar was Sarah’s maidservant.
Hagar gave birth to Ishmael for Abraham.
This is the account of Ishmael.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃

passages.text: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Hagar, who was Egyptian and Sarah’s maidservant, gave birth to Ishmael for Abraham.
Ishmael had sons.
These are the names of Ishmael’s sons.
Nebaioth was the firstborn son of Ishmael.
Kedar was another son of Ishmael.
Adbeel was another son of Ishmael.
Mibsam was another son of Ishmael.
Mishma was another son of Ishmael.
Dumah was another son of Ishmael.
Massa was another son of Ishmael.
Hadad was another son of Ishmael.
Tema was another son of Ishmael.
Jetur was another son of Ishmael.
Naphish was another son of Ishmael.
Kedemah was another son of Ishmael.
These sons were born to Ishmael in this order.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֑ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃ וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃ חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃

passages.text: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Hagar, who was Egyptian and Sarah’s maidservant, gave birth to Ishmael for Abraham.
Ishmael had sons.
These are the sons of Ishmael.
Each son had a name.
Each son lived in a village or an encampment.
There were twelve sons in total.
Each son became a prince.
Each prince led his own tribe.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃

passages.text: Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Ishmael lived for 137 years.
Ishmael died.
Ishmael was gathered to his people.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael had descendants.
Ishmael’s descendants settled in a region.
They lived from Havilah to Shur.
Shur is near the border of Egypt.
This area is on the way to Asshur.
Ishmael’s descendants lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־ שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃פ

passages.text: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac, and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was the son of Abraham.
Abraham became the father of Isaac.
Isaac married Rebekah when he was forty years old.
Rebekah was the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean.
Bethuel lived in Paddan-aram.
Rebekah was the sister of Laban the Aramean.
Isaac took Rebekah as his wife.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃ וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־ רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. And the LORD heard his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was Abraham’s son.
Isaac’s wife was Rebekah.
Rebekah could not have children.
Isaac prayed to the LORD for his wife.
The LORD heard Isaac’s prayer.
Rebekah became pregnant.
passages.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD, and He declared to her: “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
passages.sermon:
Rebekah was Isaac’s wife.
She became pregnant after God answered Isaac’s prayer.
The children inside Rebekah struggled with each other.
Rebekah noticed this struggle.
She said, “Why is this happening to me?”
Rebekah wanted to understand.
She went to ask the LORD.
The LORD answered Rebekah.
He said, “Two nations are in your womb.”
He said, “Two peoples will come from inside you.”
He said, “These two peoples will be separated.”
He said, “One people will be stronger than the other.”
He said, “The older will serve the younger.”
passages.original: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י גֹיִים בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: When her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
passages.sermon:
Rebekah was Isaac’s wife.
Rebekah became pregnant after God answered Isaac’s prayer.
The time came for Rebekah to give birth.
Rebekah had twins in her womb.
passages.original: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
passages.sermon:
Rebekah gave birth to twins.
The first baby was born.
He looked red.
His body was covered with hair like a fur coat.
They named him Esau.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: After this, his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
Esau was the first twin.
After Esau, his brother was born.
The brother held Esau’s heel as he came out.
They named this brother Jacob.
passages.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָד֤וֹ אֹחֶ֙זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
passages.sermon:
Esau and Jacob were twin brothers.
They grew up.
Esau became a skillful hunter.
Esau was a man who spent time in the fields.
Jacob was a quiet man.
Jacob stayed at home in the tents.
passages.original: וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃

passages.text: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved Esau; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
Isaac loved Esau.
Isaac loved Esau because Esau brought him wild game to eat.
Rebekah was the mother of Esau and Jacob.
Rebekah loved Jacob.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־ עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־ צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
One day, Jacob cooked some stew.
Esau was a skillful hunter and a man of the field.
Esau came in from the field.
Esau was very tired and hungry.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃

passages.text: He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom.)
passages.sermon:
Esau was Isaac’s son.
Esau came in from the field.
Esau was very hungry.
Jacob was cooking stew.
Esau spoke to Jacob.
Esau said, “Let me eat some of that red stew.”
Esau said, “I am very tired.”
People called Esau “Edom” because of the red stew.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־ הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: “First sell me your birthright,” Jacob replied.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the younger brother of Esau.
Jacob saw that Esau was hungry.
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob said, “Sell me your birthright today.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃

passages.text: “Look,” said Esau, “I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?”
passages.sermon:
Esau was the older son of Isaac.
Esau was very hungry.
Esau felt weak.
Esau said, “I am about to die.”
Esau asked, “What use is a birthright to me?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: “Swear to me first,” Jacob said. So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the younger son of Isaac and Rebekah.
Esau was Jacob’s older brother.
Jacob wanted Esau’s birthright.
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob said, “Swear to me first.”
Esau agreed.
Esau swore to Jacob.
Esau sold his birthright to Jacob.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־ בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the younger son of Isaac.
Esau was the older son of Isaac.
Jacob gave bread to Esau.
Jacob gave lentil stew to Esau.
Esau ate the bread and stew.
Esau drank.
Esau stood up.
Esau went away.
Esau despised his birthright.
passages.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־ הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס
